biography: Nat Hodgkiss, hailing from a small market town in rural Leicestershire, discovered his passion for speed not on the track, but behind the wheel of his grandfather's beat-up old Land Rover on the family farm. Hours spent navigating muddy fields instilled in him an innate understanding of vehicle dynamics and a quiet confidence behind the wheel. He began karting relatively late, at age 14, but quickly made up for lost time, displaying a natural aptitude for racing. A defining moment came during a regional karting championship where, despite starting last after a mechanical failure, he clawed his way to a podium finish, showcasing his relentless determination. Transitioning to Ginetta Juniors at 17, he quickly established himself as a consistent points scorer, earning a reputation for steady progress and level-headedness. Now, at 21, Hodgkiss is making waves in the Ginetta GT4 Supercup, aiming to prove he has what it takes to climb the motorsport ladder. He is currently seeking sponsorship to make the step up to British GT.
drivingStyle: Hodgkiss is known for his smooth, calculated driving style. He prioritizes consistency over outright aggression, focusing on hitting his marks and maximizing corner exit speed. He's particularly adept at tire management, nursing his rubber throughout a race to maintain a strong pace in the closing laps. While not the flashiest driver on the grid, his methodical approach and intelligent racecraft often see him outperforming more flamboyant competitors, especially in longer races where reliability and consistency are rewarded.
rivalries: Jamie Buckland: A Ginetta Junior rival known for aggressive overtaking maneuvers that frequently resulted in contact with Hodgkiss.
Chloe 'Chaos' Carlisle: A fierce competitor in the GT4 Supercup, their rivalry stems from a controversial incident where Carlisle forced Hodgkiss wide, costing him a podium finish.
Alexi 'The Iceman' Ivanov: A cool and calculating GT rival who Hodgkiss sees as a direct competitor for the top spot, leading to intense on-track battles.
quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks, gifted to him by his grandmother, for every race.
Listens to classical music, specifically Bach, to calm his nerves before each session.
Visually traces the race track layout in the air with his finger while walking the grid before the race.
famousQuote: Racing isn't about the fastest lap; it's about the fastest race.
careerHighlight: Winning the Ginetta Junior Winter Series Championship in dominant fashion, securing three wins and two podiums in the five-race series.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the Ginetta GT4 Supercup race at Brands Hatch due to a sudden downpour, losing a guaranteed victory.
